messages:
emma-partnerships: Heads-up: LockForge (HSM) + MeridianSI want a joint Redwood Private marketplace listing and an integration pilot. Scope: SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, KMIP-based key wrap + optional HSM import. Target: pilot before mid-Dec. Who can own which pieces?

mike-sales: I can drive GTM and partner comms. Need legal to confirm co-announce terms and marketplace revenue share.

lena-legal: We'll need an NDA + co-marketing terms. Also verify LockForge compliance attestation for FIPS and any export controls.

devin-eng: Technical notes: LockForge supports KMIP over TLS (mTLS optional). MeridianSI will act as SCIM bridge and SAML IdP proxy for customers. Questions: do we surface vendor key IDs in our Console? How do we map HSM-wrapped keys to our KMS abstraction?

tori-ops: For Private deployments we need VPC peering, IP allowlist, and a plan for air-gapped customers. Ops can set up a staging peering if vendor test endpoints available.

emma-partnerships: Vendor asks for an "approved connector" reference doc and a short runbook for customers. They also want a marketplace tile ready before the co-announce slot.

devin-eng: Proposed minimal runbook (engineering):
- Obtain vendor dev cert + test KMIP endpoint
- Configure connector: endpoint, auth (client cert or token), key-wrap policy
- Test unwrap/wrap with a dev key and confirm key metadata mapping
- Validate SCIM provisioning with sample user set
(Will post a sample connector gist.)

mike-sales: Timeline: partner marketing requests co-announce week of 12/12. Legal okay with NDA turnaround?

lena-legal: NDA draft ready in 48hrs. Co-marketing TBD pending compliance docs.

tori-ops: Actionable for staging: need vendor test IPs + certs by 11/20 to meet timeline.

emma-partnerships: Action items:
- lena-legal -> NDA + co-marketing checklist (due 2024-11-03)
- mike-sales -> finalize commercial + announce schedule (due 2024-11-07)
- devin-eng -> prototype connector + runbook + sample KMIP trace (due 2024-11-15)
- tori-ops -> staging peering template + firewall checklist (due 2024-11-10)
I'll open a partner tracker and upload vendor assets.

vendor-bot: Partnership record created: LOCKFORGE+MERIDIANSI. Tracker URL: https://redwood.internal/partners/LOCKFORGE-MERIDIANSI (expires in 90d)

emma-partnerships: Great. Weekly sync Thursdays 9am starting next week. Drop any vendor certs or test endpoints here.
